# Standard Platform — llms.txt
# Machine-readable context for AI agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Antigravity, Copilot, etc.)
# https://llmstxt.org/

> Standard is an API-first SaaS platform for security, compliance, and maturity assessments
> based on the Secure Controls Framework (SCF). Multi-tenant, Cloudflare-oriented, TypeScript.

## Product

- Name: Standard
- Type: GRC + Privacy + TPRA SaaS Platform
- Architecture: API-first / Cloudflare Workers / PostgreSQL / Vectorize
- SCF Version: 2026.1
- Base URL: https://api.standard.com/v1
- Authentication: Bearer token (API Key) or session (Better Auth)

## Key Concepts

- **Assessment**: Lifecycle entity (draft → closed) governing a security/compliance review
- **SCF Control**: Normative control from the Secure Controls Framework — never inferred
- **SoA**: Statement of Applicability — scope of controls for an assessment
- **Gap Analysis**: Delta between current state and required state — append-only findings
- **TPRA**: Third-Party Risk Assessment — vendor risk scoring based on SCF controls
- **Ledger**: Append-only event log (ADR-002) — assessment_control_events table
- **KB**: Knowledge Base — client evidence store (RAG) — never normative authority

## API Endpoints (v1)

### Assessments
- GET    /v1/assessments               — list assessments (org-scoped)
- POST   /v1/assessments               — create (returns: id, status: "draft")
- GET    /v1/assessments/:id           — detail
- PATCH  /v1/assessments/:id           — update metadata

### API Keys
- GET    /v1/api-keys                  — list (masked_key only)
- POST   /v1/api-keys                  — create (raw_key returned ONCE — one-shot)
- DELETE /v1/api-keys/:id              — revoke immediately (401 instant)
- PATCH  /v1/api-keys/:id              — update name/expiration

### MCP Tools (Async — ADR-003)
- POST   /v1/mcp/dispatch              — dispatch tool → 202 + job_id
- GET    /v1/mcp/jobs/:id              — poll: pending | completed | failed
- GET    /v1/mcp/tools                 — list available tools

### Webhooks (G15)
- GET    /v1/webhooks                  — list endpoints
- POST   /v1/webhooks                  — register (signing_secret returned ONCE)
- DELETE /v1/webhooks/:id              — delete
- POST   /v1/webhooks/:id/test         — send test event
- POST   /v1/webhooks/:id/rotate-secret — rotate signing secret (one-shot)

### TPRA
- GET    /v1/tpra/vendors              — list vendors
- POST   /v1/tpra/vendors              — register vendor
- GET    /v1/tpra/assessments          — list TPRA assessments
- POST   /v1/tpra/assessments          — start TPRA for vendor
- GET    /v1/tpra/risk-scores          — calculated risk scores

## MCP Tools Available

- validar_evidencia_privacidade        — validates evidence chunk against SCF privacy controls
- calcular_score_risco_terceiro        — calculates vendor risk score from TPRA evidence
- analisar_gap_controlo               — analyzes SCF control gap vs KB evidence

All MCP tools are ASYNC. POST /v1/mcp/dispatch returns 202 + job_id. Poll /v1/mcp/jobs/:id.

## Webhook Events (G15)

Assessment: assessment.created, assessment.status_changed, assessment.closed
Gap Analysis: gap.approved
Maturity: maturity.approved
POA&M: poam.approved
Reports: report.generated
Documents: document.uploaded
TPRA: tpra.assessment.completed, vendor.risk_score.updated
Ledger: ledger.audit.alert
Security: api_key.created, api_key.revoked

## Error Format

All errors follow: { "error": { "code": "...", "message": "...", "trace_id": "trc_...", "details": [] } }

## Architecture Rules for AI Agents

- NEVER infer SCF mappings not in the normative base (packages/scf-core)
- NEVER use vector search as normative authority
- NEVER write final findings directly from LLM output (schema validation + approval gate required)
- NEVER cache API keys in DB per request — use STANDARD_CACHE KV with TTL
- NEVER call MCP tools synchronously — POST /v1/mcp/dispatch returns 202, always poll
- NEVER update assessment_control_events — it is append-only (ADR-002)
- ALWAYS scope queries by organization_id and assessment_id
- ALWAYS include trace_id in error reporting
- Compliance score = STRM weight matrix (ADR-001), NOT implementedControls/totalControls

## Repository Structure

standard-api-standard/
├── apps/api-gateway/     — Hono API (Cloudflare Workers)
├── apps/web/             — Vite SPA (React 19, Tailwind, Shadcn)
├── workers/              — Cloudflare Workflows, Queues, Ingestion
├── packages/
│   ├── assessment-engine/ — Core lifecycle rules
│   ├── scf-core/          — Normative SCF data layer
│   ├── schemas/           — Shared TypeScript contracts
│   ├── agent-runtime/     — Agent execution rules
│   ├── gap-analysis/      — Gap analysis engine
│   └── tpra/             — Third-party risk engine
├── docs/decisions/        — ADRs (ADR-001, ADR-002, ADR-003)
└── evals/                 — Synthetic fixtures + golden outputs
